name: @vexa/live
description: Nexus live capture host — the in-person meeting lane. Accepts capture.v1 microphone audio from the Nexus Chrome extension over an authenticated WebSocket, transcribes it, publishes segments onto the existing transcript spine, and marks off the call's agenda checklist as it is covered.
